subject.title: marketplace-crons: Amazon ES create falla cuando no encuentra ASIN para el EAN

question: Are the post-recovery Amazon ES logs showing the same SKUs bypassing the 24h cooldown, or only expected retries/new products with no resolvable ASIN?
rationale: Source inspection shows an intended cooldown path, but the issue’s production reopens say the signature is still live; deciding closure or code work requires live SKU-level proof.

options.title: Verify live recurrence first
options.body: Keep the issue open until BigQuery and Mongo evidence shows whether the same SKUs are violating cooldown or the logs are expected no-ASIN retries.

options.title: Promote a narrow fix
options.body: If the same SKUs are retried too soon, repair the exact recovery selector or timestamp update path.

options.title: Close as external catalog limitation
options.body: If cooldown is respected and the products simply have no Amazon ASIN, close only after documenting the intended exclusion or retry policy.

recommendation.title: Verify live recurrence first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until BigQuery and Mongo evidence shows whether the same SKUs are violating cooldown or the logs are expected no-ASIN retries.
